title: Starbloom Isles
tagline: Hop, bloom, and light the beacon across the floating sky.

plan.title: Starbloom Isles
plan.tagline: Hop, bloom, and light the beacon across the floating sky.
plan.core_loop: Hop between floating sky islands, time moving platforms and spring pads, stomp grumpy slimes, and bank star blooms on the way to the beacon portal on the last island.
plan.win_condition: Reach the beacon portal on the final island; star blooms collected are scored toward the 12-bloom target for a full-bloom finish.
plan.lose_condition: Lose all 3 lives by falling into the void or getting hit by a slime.
plan.art_direction: Saturated candy-sky palette — azure, tangerine, cream — with cel-shaded toon surfaces, thick ink outlines and a soft warm rim light on every island edge. Materials read as glossy plastic and plush: rounded grass tufts, taut rope bridges, translucent glowing star blooms. Mood is sunny, weightless and joyful; references Skylanders meets Toon Blast, lit by a high warm sun with long soft shadows.
concept_shots: The fox mid-hop between two grassy sky islands, a rope bridge sagging below, a sparkling arc of star blooms ahead, fluffy clouds far underneath.
A grumpy green slime patrolling a stone platform as the fox lands on its head with a squash-and-stretch poof, star blooms popping into the air.
The final island: the tall beacon portal rings with light as the fox dashes in, confetti bursts and the HUD reads 12/12 Star Blooms.

features: Moving platforms that shuttle the fox across wide gaps between islands
Spring pads that launch the fox to the higher bloom-rich islands
Void below the islands — falling costs a life and respawns at the last checkpoint
Checkpoint flags at island midpoints so progress is never lost
Patrol slimes to stomp or dodge, with hit flash, squash and a poof on stomp
Beacon portal goal with a light ring, confetti burst and victory banner

result.summary: Starbloom Isles: a bright toon 3D platformer where a little fox hops across floating sky islands, banks 12 of 24 star blooms to unlock the beacon portal, and dodges/stomps 4 grumpy patrol slimes. Built on the sky_islands medium level with the plan's candy-sky palette (azure to pale-gold sky, warm high sun, soft bloom), generated star-shroom and beacon-lantern props scattered along the route, extra star-bloom arcs mid-route and a ring around the goal, arcade HUD with star-bloom counter/lives/minimap, title screen with 3-2-1 countdown, and layered FX (stomp poofs + STOMP text, spring rings, collect sparkles, goal confetti, win confetti/starburst/ring). Zero console errors; autopilot runs the route, collects 26/26 blooms, triggers checkpoints and a stomp, and reaches the goal island.
changes: Tuned Look to toon_bright with warm high sun, azure-to-gold sky, gentle bloom and saturation for the candy-sky palette
Re-tagged all 24 level collectibles as star and added 7 bonus blooms (mid-route arc + goal ring)
Placed generated star_shroom props (8) and beacon_lantern props (5 + 2 flanking the goal) along the route via Assets.prop with World.heightAt placement
Created the orange/cream fox platformer player with follow camera
Gameplay.rules: star collect target 12 (locks the beacon until banked), 3 lives, 4 patrol slime enemies, onWin/onLose FX callbacks
Added event juice: stomp poof + starburst + STOMP text, bounce rings/sparkles, collect sparkles, goal confetti
Arcade HUD: star-bloom counter with generated icon, lives hearts, minimap, objective line; title screen with tagline, controls credit and 3-2-1 countdown
known_issues: Autopilot bot occasionally falls off an island edge (1 death in a 25s run); the level's own route jumps are within single-jump range for a human player

Autopilot test window is ~25s so it does not always reach the goal island in the test; the goal portal, beacon lanterns and win FX are verified in place and the win path (goalOpen -> win event -> confetti) is wired
